summary: Polaris Media ASA, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a media house company in Norway and Sweden. The company engages in newspaper and digital subscription; and advertising in printed newspapers and digital advertising campaigns. It is also involved in the printing of editorial and advertising supplements, civilian printing, and other magazines/supplements; and distribution of newspapers, as well as parcels, mail, and other goods deliveries. The company was formerly known as Adresseavisen ASA and changed its name to Polaris Media ASA in October 2008. Polaris Media ASA was founded in 1767 and is headquartered in Trondheim, Norway.
